# Seine.com

> > Your complete guide to the Seine River in Paris, featuring cruises, attractions, bridges, and travel planning resources.

Seine.com is the definitive resource for exploring Paris via its iconic river, covering major landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, and Notre-Dame Cathedral. The site provides comprehensive information on Seine River cruises, the 37 historic bridges spanning the river, top attractions along its banks, and practical travel planning tools including hotel bookings and guided tours.

## Key Topics

- Seine River
- Paris landmarks

- Boat tours
- Historic bridges

## Planning Your Visit

- [Seine.com | Plan Your Cruise on the Seine River in Paris](https://seine.com/): Homepage for Seine River cruises and Paris tour reservations
- [Visit the Seine](https://seine.com/visit-the-seine): Guide to visiting Seine River with Paris landmarks like Eiffel Tower
- [Paris Attractions Along the Seine – Top 10 Sights with Maps & Tickets](https://seine.com/attractions/): Top 10 Seine attractions: Notre-Dame, Louvre, Eiffel Tower with tickets

## Bridges of the Seine

- [The 37 Bridges Across the Seine](https://seine.com/bridges/): Directory of 37 bridges across Seine River including Pont Neuf
- [Pont d'Iéna](https://seine.com/bridges/pont-d-iena.php): Napoleonic-era Pont d'Iéna bridge with Eiffel Tower views
- [Pont Royal](https://seine.com/bridges/pont-royal.php): Historical info on Pont Royal bridge from Louis XVI era

## Accommodations

- [Paris Hotels](https://seine.com/hotels/): Paris hotel listings and accommodation booking via Booking.com
